🇬🇧 THREE NATIONALIST LEADERS, ONE DECLARATION

In Cardiff this week, the leaders of the SNP, Plaid Cymru and Sinn Fein signed a joint declaration demanding the right to hold independence referendums.

It triggers nothing on its own. But for the first time, pro-independence parties lead in all three of the UK's other nations at once — and Westminster's only answer is that a vote is "off limits" for now.

"Not now" is not an argument. 👇
